purpose: Evidence inventory for recovering and auditing historical formulas. Exact recovered legacy source files are preserved separately from current experimental implementations; known defects and unverified historical metrics remain explicitly flagged.
rules: Do not claim an experimental candidate is identical to a missing legacy formula.
Do not promote methods to canonical without explicit user approval.
Keep target draw numbers hidden and use only strictly pre-target history.
Preserve the R54 and R60 archive regimes separately.
Forward walk-forward, reverse retrospective stress testing, and chronological fold summaries are distinct protocols.
Reverse-time results are retrospective stress tests, not predictive evidence.

current_candidate.definition: Build a transition signature from the latest known A->B pair using the selected feature (default mod5diff) and transform (default sign); compare with older transition signatures; vote on the following historical draw for the closest k matches using weight 1/(1+distance); return the six highest-scoring numbers with deterministic numeric tie-break.
current_candidate.leakage_guard: Only the supplied history is used; current target draw is not an argument. Candidate transitions are restricted so their following draw is already historical and older than the current A/B pair.
current_candidate.known_limit: This is the present candidate implementation, not a verified reconstruction of the legacy V8.6 formula. Legacy registry notes describe the older evaluator as scoring B for a target transition, not establishing a canonical A->B to following C method.

current_candidate.definition: For every adjacent historical source/target draw pair, count each source number's co-occurrence with all numbers in the immediately following draw. For the latest known source draw, sum historical target-number counts associated with each of its six numbers and return the six highest-scoring numbers.
current_candidate.leakage_guard: Uses only complete adjacent pairs contained in supplied pre-target history.
current_candidate.known_limit: Current explicit candidate, not proven identical to the old gen_pair_relation implementation or an approved canonical A->T definition.

legacy_source.reported_behavior: Empirical source-number to immediately-following-draw-number co-occurrence counts.

current_candidate.definition: Represent each historical draw as the six-position tuple of number modulo 5. Compare the latest known draw's residue tuple with earlier draw residue tuples using Hamming distance; the k closest historical states vote for their already-known following draws, weighted by 1/(1+distance); return the six highest-scoring numbers.
current_candidate.leakage_guard: Each source state votes only for its following draw already present in the supplied history; the isolated target draw is not passed to this function.
current_candidate.known_limit: The legacy registry describes mod5diff as one transition feature; that feature alone does not reconstruct an approved MOD5-to-target mapping.
